summary.intent: Fix the memory loop TUI injection tab so it tests against all active memories and clearly shows whether each memory would be injected or not, replacing the confusing raw score display.
summary.outcome: Updated the injection tab to use PreviewSelection() instead of SelectRelevant(), showing INJECT/SKIP labels with skip reasons for all active memories. Two new render tests were added and all 22 tests pass.

repo: PreviewSelection() returns a SelectionReport with both Matches and Skipped fields — use this instead of SelectRelevant() when you need full coverage of all active memories
SelectRelevant() only returns memories that matched (active + token overlap); it does not return skipped memories
memoryloop.go contains injectionRejectionReason and SkippedMatch types that carry skip reasons (e.g. 'not active', 'scope mismatch', 'low strength')
testPromptResultMsg in messages.go carries the result of the prompt test; was changed from a matches-only slice to a full SelectionReport

code.finding: testPromptResultMsg was updated to carry a SelectionReport instead of just a slice of matches
Switched from SelectRelevant() to PreviewSelection() to obtain the full SelectionReport including skipped memories
View now renders a summary line ('N would inject, M skipped'), INJECT label for matches, SKIP label with reason for skipped memories
unusedwrite lint fired on activeTab field assignments in tests that called injectionTab.view() directly; fix was to remove those assignments

workflow: When a test assertion fails because a substring appears in an unrelated section, inspect the full rendered output before assuming the feature is broken
unusedwrite lint catches struct field assignments whose values are never read — remove them rather than suppressing with nolint

friction: ExitPlanMode was interrupted twice by the user before implementation began, requiring a replanning pass
Initial empty-state test assertion for 'no INJECT results' matched a substring inside 'RECENT INJECTIONS' section header, causing a false failure that required fixing the assertion
